title: Winning at programming competitions is a negative factor for being good on the job
summary: A one-minute clip of Peter Norvig saying that Google found programming contest success correlates negatively or poorly with job performance. The description links to a blog post discussing it.
why: Used as the go-to citation in LeetCode and hiring debates that competitive programming skill is not a good signal for hiring.

quote.text: Peter Norvig discussed an analysis at Google that suggested doing well at coding contests was a negative indicator of job performance
